rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution the President appoints Dmitry Anatolyevich Medvedev Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation; in force on signing. Signed "Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин", Moscow, Kremlin, 8 May 2012, No. 612.
rows.locator: PDF page 1: points 1-2; signature and date block
